groups.name: hazelcast.toolkit.network
groups.description: Connection settings shared by client and member modes.

groups.name: hazelcast.toolkit.metrics
groups.description: Micrometer metrics and diagnostic endpoint settings.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.cluster-name
properties.description: Shared cluster name for client and member modes. Overrides the legacy mode-specific cluster-name properties when set.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.enterprise-license-key
properties.description: Shared Hazelcast Enterprise license key for client and member modes.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.network.seed-members
properties.description: Shared seed member addresses used for client connections and member TCP/IP discovery.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.compact.base-package
properties.description: Root package scanned for Hazelcast Compact serialization annotations.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.client.base-name
properties.description: Toolkit-managed Hazelcast client name prefix.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.instance.mode
properties.description: Hazelcast instance creation mode: CLIENT, MEMBER, or NONE.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.member.instance-name
properties.description: Optional Hazelcast member instance name used in member mode.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.member.cluster-name
properties.description: Hazelcast cluster name used by the embedded member.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.member.network.port
properties.description: Hazelcast member network port.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.member.network.port-auto-increment
properties.description: Whether Hazelcast can increment the member port if the configured port is busy.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.member.network.public-address
properties.description: Optional public address advertised by the Hazelcast member.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.member.network.join.auto-detection-enabled
properties.description: Enable Hazelcast member auto-detection discovery.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.member.network.join.multicast-enabled
properties.description: Enable Hazelcast member multicast discovery.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.member.network.join.tcp-ip-members
properties.description: Static TCP/IP member addresses used by the embedded member.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable Micrometer MeterBinder beans for Hazelcast near-cache and Hibernate L2 metrics.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.metrics.diagnostic-endpoint.enabled
properties.description: Enable the optional /hz-toolkit diagnostic HTTP endpoints. This is separate from Micrometer metrics publishing.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.health.enabled
properties.description: Enable the optional Hazelcast toolkit HealthIndicator for /actuator/health.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.actuator.near-cache-check.enabled
properties.description: Register the /actuator/hazelcastNearCache endpoint.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.actuator.near-cache-check.entity-class
properties.description: Fully-qualified cacheable JPA entity class used by the near-cache probe.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.actuator.near-cache-check.entity-id
properties.description: Primary-key value of the probe entity. The endpoint converts it to the JPA metamodel id type.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.spring-cache.mode
properties.description: Spring Cache manager mode: JCACHE, NATIVE, or NONE.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.hibernate.l2.enabled
properties.description: Activate Hibernate second-level cache auto-configuration.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.hibernate.l2.region-factory
properties.description: Hibernate L2 RegionFactory mode: JCACHE, HAZELCAST_LOCAL, or HAZELCAST.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.hibernate.l2.extended-config
properties.description: Apply the full Hibernate L2 property set while preserving explicit application settings.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.hibernate.l2.use-query-cache
properties.description: Enable Hibernate query cache when extended L2 configuration is active.

properties.name: hazelcast.toolkit.hibernate.l2.use-statistics
properties.description: Enable Hibernate cache statistics when extended L2 configuration is active.

values.description: Create a Hazelcast client that connects to an external cluster.

Expose a Spring JCacheCacheManager backed by the toolkit-managed JCache CacheManager.

Do not auto-configure a Spring CacheManager.
